verdict.rationale: Mintlify docs confirm git-based workflows: content changes via Git, PR preview deployments for reviewing changes before merge, editor-based PR review/merge, and CLI for local preview/build validation before deploy, plus automations triggered on repository pushes. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of the git branch/PR/merge pipeline in practice, and no detail on branch-based environment mapping or merge conflict handling.
